create_class_random_affine_flow: create a RandomAffineFlow module that applies random affine transforms to images and optical flow with configurable zoom, rotation, and translation
apply_transform_to_params: apply a random affine transform to existing affine parameters by composing two sets of 6-parameter theta vectors
create_class_random_mirror: create a RandomMirror module that randomly flips affine parameters horizontally and vertically with configurable probability
transform_image_with_affine: transform images using affine parameters by computing inverse coordinates and bilinearly interpolating pixel values
transform_flow_with_affine: transform optical flow fields by computing inverse coordinate mappings for source and target frames and subtracting to produce new flow
